errors.text_span: Линията започва на стойност около 3% през 2000 г.
errors.evidence: The data line does not start in the year 2000, nor at 3%. The data begins around 2011 with a value of approximately 7%.

errors.text_span: и се покачва постепенно до приблизително 38% през 2050 г.
errors.evidence: The final data point in 2050 is at approximately 42%, not 38%.

errors.text_span: Между 2010 и 2020 г. рязко се увеличава от около 6% до приблизително 16%.
errors.evidence: This description of the data points between 2010 and 2020 is inaccurate. The data starts around 7% in 2011 and reaches about 13% by 2015. The values 6% and 16% do not correspond correctly to the data points shown in that interval.

errors.text_span: От 2020 г. до 2040 г. стойността нараства от приблизително 20% до 32%.
errors.evidence: The value in 2020 is not 20%. Based on the trendline, the value at 2020 would be approximately 17%.

errors.text_span: Линията започва на стойност около 0.3 от оста Y през 2000 г. и се покачва постепенно до приблизително 3.8 от оста Y през 2050 г.
errors.evidence: This entire sentence is a hallucination. The dotted line is a logarithmic trendline plotted on the same Y-axis (0-45%) as the main data. It does not have its own scale or values like 0.3 or 3.8. The description invents a completely different meaning and set of values for this line.
